en.headline: Parking meter system restored after nearly four-hour outage
en.dek: Transport Department says the citywide system is back to normal after emergency repairs; no evidence of attack, and operator must submit a report within 24 hours.
body: The Transport Department said the parking meter system had resumed normal operation on Tuesday afternoon after an outage that began when the operator reported a malfunction at about 8.20am.

Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said the department had instructed the operator, Hong Kong Telecom, to submit a report as soon as possible. She hoped an initial report would arrive within the next 24 hours. The department said there was currently no evidence the system had been attacked and that the Digital Policy Office had been notified.

Earlier, police had held off enforcement at roadside metered spaces while the system was down. Motorists with remaining queries can call the service hotline at 2332 3700. The department said it would continue to press the operator for a thorough investigation to prevent a recurrence.

zh.headline: 全港咪錶泊車系統已恢復正常運作
zh.dek: 運輸署指營運商緊急搶修後系統復常，暫無證據顯示遭攻擊，並要求盡快提交報告。
body: 運輸署表示，全港咪錶泊車系統於周二下午已恢復正常運作。署方今早約8時20分接獲營運商報告系統故障，其後進行緊急搶修。
運輸及物流局局長陳美寶表示，已責成營運商香港電訊盡快提交報告，期望初步報告可於未來24小時內交到。署方指目前沒有證據顯示系統遭攻擊，並已通報數字政策辦公室。
系統故障期間，警方暫緩對路旁咪錶泊位執法。駕駛人士如有查詢，可致電服務熱線2332 3700。運輸署表示會繼續督促營運商徹查原因，防止同類事件再發生。
